content: आप्यायन {%a.%} Causing fulness or stoutness, promoting welfare. .{@-नम्, -ना@} [प्याय्-ल्युट्] .²1 The act of making full or fat; क्लेदनं पिण्डनं तृप्तिः प्राणनाप्यायनोन्दनम् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 26. 43</ls>. .²2 Satisfying, refreshing, pleasing. .²3 Satisfaction, satiety; देवस्याप्यायना भवति <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 211</ls>. .²4 Advancing, promoting. .²5 Corpulency, growing fat or stout. .²6 Anything which causes corpulency or good condition. .²7 A strengthening medicine. .²8 Pouring water on Soma and thus causing it to swell.
